items.name: like-button
items.title: Like Button
items.description: A like toggle that overshoots on press and settles with a spring.

items.name: scrub
items.title: Scrub
items.description: A seek bar whose precision increases as the pointer pulls away from the track.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold To Confirm
items.description: A destructive action that costs a second of deliberate pressure, and unwinds if you let go.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: A destructive action's grace period, with a visible clock that pauses when you reach for it.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: An accordion panel whose height is a spring you can interrupt mid-flight, not a duration that has to finish first.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A draggable panel that snaps to the detent your release velocity projects toward, not the one nearest where your hand happened to stop.

items.name: reorder
items.title: Reorder
items.description: A drag-to-reorder list where the displaced rows don't move together — each settles with a spring softened by its distance from the row you dragged, so the shift travels down the list as a wave.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide To Confirm
items.description: A drag-to-commit gesture that fails safe with a recoil carrying your release velocity, so how close the attempt got is something you feel, not just a snap back to zero.

items.name: revert-field
items.title: Revert Field
items.description: A text field where Escape rewinds an edit as a watched un-typing, deleting to the shared prefix and typing the prior value back in, instead of silently snapping the string back.

items.name: scheduler
items.title: Scheduler
items.description: A date-and-time booking picker where hovering a slot raises a dim, question-marked preview of the confirmation before you've committed to anything, and month navigation is an interruptible spring, not a crossfade.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: Use Controllable State
items.description: State that is uncontrolled by default and controlled when a value is passed.

items.name: z-cn
items.title: Z Class Names
items.description: Class name merge helper that resolves conflicting Tailwind utilities in favor of the consumer.

items.name: z-spring
items.title: Z Spring
items.description: The Z-UI spring scale and the transition hook that honors prefers-reduced-motion.
